table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	HotKey = 0,
	Name = LEFT(I.Name, 20),
	LFCode=I.CustomICode,
	Code=I.CustomICode,
	BarCodeType=CASE WHEN I.AllowSaleInDecimalQty = 'Y' THEN 7 ELSE 9 END,
	UnitPrice= CAST(STR(ROUND(I.SalePrice * 100, 0), 10) AS INT),
	UnitWeight =CASE WHEN I.AllowSaleInDecimalQty = 'Y' THEN 4 ELSE 9 END,
/*	UnitAmount = 0.00,*/
	Department=(SELECT CAST(WS.ScaleID AS INT) FROM WeighingScale WS WHERE WS.WeighingScaleCode = :ai_weighingscalecode),
	PTWeight = CASE WHEN I.AllowSaleInDecimalQty = 'Y' THEN 0.000 ELSE 0 END,
	ShelfTime=15,
	PackType = 0,
	Tare=0.000,
	Error=0,
	Message1=0,
	Message2=0,
	Label=0,
	DiscountTable=0,
	Account=0,
	PluTitle=0,
	Account2=0,
	RecommendedDays=0,
	Nutrition=0
FROM 
	Item I
WHERE
	CASE :as_grouping 
	WHEN 'M' THEN I.ManfCode 
	WHEN 'C' THEN I.ICatCode 
	WHEN 'L' THEN I.ICCode 
	WHEN 'P' THEN I.PackCode 
	END IN (:ai_groupcode) AND
	LEN(I.CustomICode) <= (SELECT WS.itemendpos - WS.itemstartpos + 1 FROM WeighingScale WS WHERE WS.WeighingScaleCode = :ai_weighingscalecode)
ORDER BY
	Code
